name: CHNEP Conservation Grants
summary: Small reimbursement grants for community organisations in the 10-county Florida CHNEP region, for clean water, estuarine habitat protection and restoration, and public engagement projects. Work on private property is excluded.

eligibility.rule: Project avoids restoration or improvements on private property
Project is not an admission-fee event or service, except qualifying scholarships
Project does not personally benefit the applicant
Project excludes political action or legislative advocacy
Project has not been completed before the grant award
Project excludes activities related to permitting

documents: One-page resume for project lead or organization

calls.label: FY27 Conservation Grants

status.quote: Applications for FY27 will open October 1, 2026 and are due before December 1, 2026 for a January 2027 award notice. Applications submitted after December 1, 2026, but before April 1, 2027, will receive a May 2027 award notice.

opens.quote: Applications for FY27 will open October 1, 2026

deadline.quote: Applications submitted after December 1, 2026, but before April 1, 2027, will receive a May 2027 award notice.

calls.note: First round due before December 1, 2026; later applications until April 1, 2027 get a May 2027 award notice.

applicant_types.quote: The CHNEP provides Conservation Grants (up to $9,999) to community organizations for projects that address clean water, wildlife habitat protection and restoration, and outreach priorities in the CHNEP area

geography.quote: To check to see if your project is in the CHNEP 10-county region

access.quote: Applications for FY27 will open October 1, 2026 and are due before December 1, 2026 for a January 2027 award notice. Applications submitted after December 1, 2026, but before April 1, 2027, will receive a May 2027 award notice.

window.quote: After April 1, 2027, CHNEP Conservation Grants will be closed until October 1, 2028.

amount.quote: Conservation grants are in the $500 to $9,999 range and are reimbursement-based.

co_finance_required.quote: Match is not required, but proposals showing matching fund commitment through in-kind services (such as volunteer hours), or direct funding from other sources will receive special consideration.

effort.quote: Applications should be submitted via email to Grants@chnep.org.

eligibility.quote: Restoration or improvements on private property
Events or services for which there is an admission fee or charge; CHNEP will consider providing support for scholarships to allow participation by those who would not otherwise be able to attend
Projects that personally benefit the applicant
Projects/phase of project completed prior to the award of the grant

after_award.quote: A Final Report will be the deliverable for the project and is required for lump-sum based reimbursement.

documents.quote: A one-page resume for the project lead or organization. A project timeline Project area map
